docs/testing-conventions.md:
# Approved project testing conventions

Java 21 and Spring Boot 4.1.1 are pinned by the build. HTTP binding, Jakarta validation,
serialization and exception-to-status mapping require real Spring MVC slice behavior.
Use org.springframework.boot.webmvc.test.autoconfigure.WebMvcTest and
org.springframework.test.context.bean.override.mockito.MockitoBean as supported by this build.
Use MockMvc with the real QuoteController, keeping only PricingService mocked.
Do not start a live server, disable validation, replace the controller or alter application code.
README.md:
# Accepted quote HTTP requirements

POST /quotes consumes a JSON object with sku, a nonblank string whose original length is2..12,
including both endpoints. Null, empty, blank, one-character and thirteen-character values return400
without calling PricingService. Malformed JSON also returns400 without calling the collaborator.
After validation, trim only surrounding spaces, preserving case and internal characters.
Call PricingService.quote once with that normalized SKU. Return201 and JSON fields sku and
unitPrice with the exact normalized SKU and the BigDecimal plain string including decimal scale.
A collaborator IllegalStateException maps to503 and JSON code pricing-unavailable, without unitPrice.
Use focused framework slice tests for validation, binding, serialization and exception mapping.
The README requirements, not existing bugs or implementation shortcuts, define expected behavior.
